{{Top|leg}}
'''Crêpes Malreaux''' were created by the [[Tac-Spec Corporation|Tac-Spec]] [[FIII Footman droid]] [[Fidelis]] for the Ninth [[Malreaux|Viscount Malreaux]] of [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. It has been warmly commended for the last eight generations.

Fidelis served it once more to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Scout]] aboard the ''[[Nighthawk]]'', a [[B-7 light freighter]] [[starship]] purchased by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. However, instead of using [[Acid-beet]]s as the customary sidedish, Fidelis was forced to make do with [[dried whip-smelt]], [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]], [[Reythan cracker]]s and a [[Souse-mustard]] tapenade for appetizers.
